{{Top|leg}}
The '''Royal Bedchamber''' was the bedchamber of the [[Queen Mother]] of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] and was located in the [[Fountain Palace]] on [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]] connected to the [[Queen's Drawing Room]]. The room was dominated by a huge [[Sleeper (furniture)|bed]] covered by a crown-shaped canopy, which was surrounded by other furniture, including many couches, armchairs, and writing desks. It had two other rooms that in [[36 ABY]] included a simple sleeping pallet that [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]] preferred to sleep on and in the farthest room, a crib for her baby [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]]. It was here that [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] came to meet the Queen in 36 ABY, when he discovered he was Allana's father.
